C1511.title: Security and Privacy Analysis of Extended Reality Devices
C1511.summary: Published in February 2024, this study reviews extended reality security and privacy from a device-centered perspective. It covers attacks against headsets, sensors, interaction data, and immersive applications and surveys existing defenses. The paper emphasizes privacy risks created by continuous collection of environmental and user information and proposes design considerations and research directions that balance security, privacy, and usability.
